idea-plugin.name: GitHub Copilot Premium Quota Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
GitHub Copilot Premium Quota Monitor is a plugin for the IntelliJ platform that helps you monitor the remaining quota of the GitHub Copilot premium model directly from the IDE status bar.

  • Double-click on the widget for an immediate quota refresh without opening any menu.
  • Configurable alert thresholds and colors: set your own critical (default 10%) and warning (default 30%) quota percentage thresholds, each with a personalized color. Per-setting "Reset to default" buttons are provided for convenience.
  • Full compatibility with all JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, etc.).
  • Localization support: Albanian, Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish.
  • Manual and automatic background updates of quota data.
  • Quick actions via widget popup (left single-click): Refresh, Sign In, Sign Out.
  • Real-time status bar widget showing the remaining premium quota as a percentage, with color-coded urgency levels.
  • Secure authentication via OAuth Device Flow, with tokens stored in PasswordSafe.
  • Tooltip with detailed quota information, including remaining requests and renewal date.
  • Visual feedback for loading, unlimited plans, unauthenticated state, and errors.

A GitHub account with an active Copilot subscription is required. The plugin is independent from the official GitHub Copilot plugin and works with all compatible JetBrains IDEs.

Simple to use, secure, and designed to keep you informed about your Copilot premium quota usage at a glance. Use left-click on the widget to open the quick actions menu.

Credits: Special thanks to the contributors who helped improve this plugin:

  • Fabio Pelliccia
  • Massimo Ambrosino
  • Vincenzo Pimpinella
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.1.0

  • Renamed the "Interactions" label to "AI Credits" in the status bar tooltip, updated across all supported languages (Albanian, Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish).

Version 1.0.7

  • Fixed: Internal API is private and must not be used outside of the IntelliJ Platform itself. Please proceed with the next steps described in this article - PluginManagerCore.getPlugin(PluginId).

Version 1.0.6

  • Added Open GitHub Copilot Dashboard action to the status bar widget popup menu: opens https://github.com/settings/copilot directly in the system browser.
  • Fixed hardcoded User-Agent version: the HTTP header now reflects the actual installed plugin version, resolved at runtime via the IntelliJ plugin descriptor.
  • Fixed HTTP connection resource leak: HttpURLConnection.disconnect() is now always called in a finally block for all API requests (quota fetch, device code, token poll, username fetch).
  • Fixed response stream resource leak: BufferedReader instances are now closed via use {} after reading the response body.

Version 1.0.5

  • Changed the status bar widget for unlimited quota to display only the infinity symbol (∞) across all supported languages.

Version 1.0.4

  • Changed the warning threshold default from 20% to 30%.
  • Configurable quota alert thresholds: set a custom critical (default 10%) and warning (default 30%) percentage threshold directly from Settings → Tools → GitHub Copilot Premium Quota Monitor.
  • Configurable alert colors: choose a custom color for each threshold; each setting includes a dedicated "Reset to default" button for convenience.
  • Changed default critical color to pure red.
  • Changed default warning color from orange to yellow.
  • Fixed verify plugin Gradle task.
  • Inline cross-field validation in the Settings panel: the critical threshold is enforced to be strictly less than the warning threshold, with real-time feedback while editing.
  • Refined quota display precision: integer percentages are now shown without trailing decimals, and non-integer values keep one decimal digit.
  • Unified casing to "GitHub Copilot" and applied context-aware naming policy (full name for detailed views, "GHCP" for status bar) to improve user experience across all translations.
  • Updated plugin title.

Version 1.0.3

  • Added contributor credits in plugin description (Fabio Pelliccia, Massimo Ambrosino, Vincenzo Pimpinella) and performed general source cleanup/formatting improvements.
  • Added widget blinking on refresh to provide visual feedback of update action.
  • Automatic background refresh (default 5 minutes) now can be customized by IDE settings dialog.
  • Double-click on the status bar widget now triggers an immediate quota refresh without opening any menu.
  • Enhanced usage details in tooltip: interactions now display "X of Y" when total quota is available, otherwise "X calls".
  • Fixed forced/manual refresh not invoked.
  • Improved logging for better debugging and monitoring of plugin behavior.
  • Improved UI consistency: standard IDE icons for popup "Sign in" / "Sign out", and aligned "Open in Browser" button height with "Copy Code".
  • Improved widget UX clarity: left single-click opens the quick-action popup; double-click refreshes immediately.
  • Localization updates and quality improvements for: Albanian (sq), Chinese (zh), French (fr), German (de), Italian (it), Japanese (ja), Portuguese (pt), Russian (ru), Spanish (es), and Turkish (tr).
  • Refined status bar tooltip readability and consistency: wider layout, rounded interactions value, and renamed label from "Quota" to "Remaining quota" (localized).
  • Renewal date in tooltip is now formatted according to the active UI locale.
  • Terminology unified to "GitHub CoPilot" in sign-in dialog header and status bar labels across all languages.

Version 1.0.0

  • Initial release with core features: status bar widget, quota monitoring, authentication, and basic UI.
